results.title: NFL Legend Turned HBCU Coach Marshall Faulk Shares Heartbreaking Health Update
results.description: Marshall Faulk spent 12 NFL seasons taking brutal hits, but the warning sign of his latest health battle came somewhere nobody expected: a golf course. The Hall of Famer initially dismissed the stiffness in his hand as nothing serious.
